problem.text_en: Unit Intermittently Fails During Cold Startup Validation
problem.text_zh: 低温启动验证中设备间歇性失败

event_detail.title: Event Detail
event_detail.text: The unit sometimes fails to complete cold startup validation after overnight storage and requires a full power cycle to recover.
bullets: Scope includes engineering samples from two assembly lots

checks.text_en: Input voltage remains within the specified startup window?
checks.text_zh: 输入电压是否保持在启动规格窗口内？

fail_conclusion.detail_en: Review adapter, harness, and connector contact resistance.

checks.text_en: Firmware version and boot configuration match the released validation baseline?
checks.text_zh: 固件版本和启动配置是否符合验证基线？

checks.text_en: Thermal chamber ramp and soak conditions match the test method?
checks.text_zh: 温箱升降温和保温条件是否符合测试方法？

final_pass_conclusion.text_en: No issue found in this path. Continue with rare causes or deeper electrical analysis.
final_pass_conclusion.text_zh: 该路径未发现异常。继续检查少见原因或进行更深入电气分析。
